reviews.t: Christmount does a fantastic job with food and hospitality. Organizations can use facilities for meetings or retreats. Families can hold reunions and retreats. Walking trails and pool on property
Clean, friendly staff, reasonable fee ( donations), delicious and reasonable proportions of food. Wheelchair accessible.
